dates.name: Utah Food Festival — Culinary Heritage Celebration
dates.desc: Celebrate Utah's rich culinary heritage from ancient ancestral foods to contemporary delicacies. Sample from local artisans, attend expert-led culinary workshops, and explore food history with insightful presentations. Pair with museum galleries for a full day of discovery and culture.
dates.where: Natural History Museum of Utah — 301 S 1300 E, Salt Lake City, UT 84112

dates.name: Living Traditions Festival — Final Day of Celebration
dates.desc: Celebrate international cultures and traditions on the festival's final day! Experience music, dance, food, and cultural performances from around the world. Perfect for an afternoon stroll with live entertainment and diverse cuisines. Relaxed, educational, and joyful atmosphere.
dates.where: Washington Square Park — Salt Lake City, UT

dates.name: Dethklok & Amon Amarth: The Amonklok Conquest
dates.desc: High-energy metal concert featuring Swedish Viking metal legends Amon Amarth with Dethklok and Castle Rat. Thunderous performances, electrifying stage presence, and devoted metal fan community. Similar energy to hockey games—loud, intense, and unforgettable for rock lovers.
dates.where: The Union Event Center — 465 S 400 W, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Echo & The Bunnymen — More Songs to Learn & Sing Tour
dates.desc: Legendary post-punk icons Echo & The Bunnymen celebrate their 40+ year career with hits spanning 1978-2026. Beautiful, atmospheric post-punk classics in an intimate venue. Perfect for music lovers who appreciate sophisticated, artistic performances.
dates.where: The Union Event Center — 465 S 400 W, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: RIVERDANCE — The World's #1 Dance Show
dates.desc: The phenomenal dance spectacle that captivated millions worldwide! Stunning choreography, rhythmic percussion, and world-class Irish and contemporary dancers. If you loved Phantom of the Opera, you'll be mesmerized by RIVERDANCE's artistry, elegance, and pure magic on stage. Iconic, unforgettable experience.
dates.where: Eccles Theater — 131 S Main St, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Billy Joel & Sting in Concert
dates.desc: Two music legends perform their greatest hits! Billy Joel's piano classics and Sting's sophisticated rock blend for an unforgettable evening of iconic music. Incredible artistry, storytelling, and nostalgia. Rare opportunity to see these hall-of-famers together.
dates.where: Rice-Eccles Stadium — 451 S 1400 E, Salt Lake City, UT 84112

dates.name: Garden Bros Nuclear Circus — America's Favorite Family Circus
dates.desc: World-class circus spectacle! Human Cannonball, Wheel of Death, Motorcycles in the Sphere of Fear, Human Slingshot, Chinese Acrobats, clowns, and comedy. Modern, climate-controlled Big Top with non-stop action and 60+ international performers.
dates.start: Multiple showtimes: 4:30 PM & 7:30 PM (weekdays), 1:30/4:30/7:30 PM (Sat), 1/4/7 PM (Sun)
dates.where: Utah State Fairpark — North Area, Salt Lake City, UT
dates.reservation: recommended (buy in advance for best prices)

dates.name: Mirror Lake Scenic Byway Road Trip & Alpine Adventure
dates.desc: Drive Utah's stunning 42-mile scenic byway through the Uinta Mountains. Crystal-clear alpine lakes, towering peaks, wildflowers, and alpine vistas at 10,715 feet. Stop for picnicking, short hikes to Mirror Lake, or fishing. One of your favorite types of dates—outdoor exploration with incredible scenery.
dates.where: Mirror Lake Highway — State Route 150, Kamas, UT to Wyoming border (1.5 hrs from SLC)

dates.name: Totally Rad Vintage Fest — 80s/90s/Y2K Nostalgia
dates.desc: Browse and shop curated vintage clothing, accessories, toys, and home goods from the 80s, 90s, and Y2K eras. Free-to-play vintage arcade games and the Rad Rewind Museum with retro memorabilia. Fun, quirky, nostalgic vibe—fulfilling your 'totally rad vintage fest' wishlist!
dates.where: Mountain America Exposition Center — 9575 State St, Sandy, UT 84070

dates.name: Rockport Reservoir — Scenic Alpine Lake Adventure
dates.desc: Your favorite type of date! Crystal-clear alpine waters nestled in the Uinta Mountains. Perfect for kayaking, paddleboarding, or shoreline picnicking. Beautiful in late May with warmer weather. Multiple scenic viewpoints, peaceful fishing areas, and cabin rentals available.
dates.where: Rockport State Park — Coalville, UT (1 hr north from SLC)

dates.name: Antelope Island State Park — Bison & Wildflower Scenic Loop
dates.desc: Drive the stunning 7-mile scenic loop spotting native bison herds, pronghorn, bighorn sheep. May wildflowers are peak. Great Salt Lake backdrop with sunset views. Your type of exploration date.
dates.where: Antelope Island State Park — 4528 W 1700 S, Syracuse, UT 84075

dates.name: Emerald Pools Trail — Zion Canyon Waterfall Hikes
dates.desc: Stunning waterfall hikes in Zion. Choose between Lower Pool (easy 1 mile), Middle Pool (2.6 miles), or Upper Pool (3 miles). Emerald waters, hanging gardens, and mist from waterfalls. World-class scenery.
dates.where: Zion National Park — Emerald Pools Trail, Springdale, UT (2.5 hrs south)

dates.name: Snowbird Alpine Loop Scenic Drive & Mountain Views
dates.desc: Scenic byway through the Wasatch Mountains. Option to ride the 2,000-foot aerial tram to Hidden Peak (11,000 ft) for 360° alpine views and dinner at the summit. Accessible, romantic, unforgettable.
dates.where: Snowbird Resort & Little Cottonwood Canyon — Snowbird, UT (45 min east)

dates.name: Bear Lake — Crystal Turquoise Alpine Water Sports
dates.desc: Pristine alpine lake with stunning turquoise water. Peaceful paddling perfect for your love of lake dates. Multiple access points, beautiful mountain scenery, sunset paddling opportunities.
dates.where: Bear Lake State Park — Garden City, UT (1.5 hrs north)

dates.name: Dinner at Handle — Park City Chef-Driven Dining
dates.desc: Intimate restaurant with Dave Jones' celebrated seasonal small plates. Fresh fish, heritage meats, creative vegetables. Excellent wine list, sophisticated yet approachable. Cozy, romantic atmosphere.
dates.where: Handle — Park City, UT (30 min from SLC)

dates.name: Dinner at Log Haven — Millcreek Canyon Fine Dining
dates.desc: Scenic mountain setting four miles up Millcreek Canyon. Chef Dave Jones' Southwestern-influenced menu, beautiful views, excellent service. Romantic and just minutes from downtown.
dates.where: Log Haven — Millcreek Canyon, Salt Lake City, UT

dates.name: Dinner at The Tree Room — Sundance Mountain Dining
dates.desc: Tucked into the mountains at Sundance. Seasonal American cuisine with mountain views. Rustic elegance, exceptional service, fireplace ambiance. Romantic escape from the city.
dates.where: The Tree Room — Sundance Resort, UT (45 min south)

dates.name: Dinner at APEX — Montage Deer Valley Fine Steakhouse
dates.desc: Elegant fine dining with sweeping mountain views. Exceptional steaks, fresh seafood, impeccable service. Expert wine pairings, luxurious ambiance. Perfect special occasion date.
dates.where: APEX at Montage Deer Valley — Park City, UT

dates.name: Local Brewery Food Tour — Downtown SLC Dining & Craft Beer
dates.desc: Explore Salt Lake's vibrant food scene paired with craft breweries. Tapas-style tastings, local artisan foods, craft beer pairings. Great conversation and discovery experience.
dates.where: Various locations — Downtown Salt Lake City

dates.name: Broadway Theater Productions — Eccles Theater
dates.desc: World-class theatrical performances. Since you gave Phantom of the Opera a perfect 5 stars, check the Eccles schedule for similar high-caliber musicals and plays. Stunning productions, exceptional talent.
dates.where: Eccles Theater — 131 S Main St, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Utah Symphony — Classical & Film Score Concerts
dates.desc: World-class orchestra performing classical masterworks and iconic film scores. Romantic, sophisticated, culturally enriching. Check schedule for spring/summer offerings.
dates.where: Abravanel Hall — 123 W South Temple, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Natural History Museum of Utah — Paleontology & Discovery
dates.desc: World-class museum with 60,000+ fossils, interactive exhibits, stunning valley views. Educational, fascinating, perfect for exploration and learning together. Pair with nearby Red Butte Garden.
dates.where: Natural History Museum of Utah — 301 S 1300 E, Salt Lake City, UT 84112

dates.name: Salt Lake Arts District Gallery Walk & Coffee
dates.desc: Explore vibrant downtown arts district. Local artists, contemporary installations, rotating exhibits. Grab coffee, discuss art together, discover new favorites. First Friday for special events.
dates.where: Salt Lake City Arts District — Downtown SLC

dates.name: Red Butte Garden — Botanical Gardens & Spring Beauty
dates.desc: Utah's premier botanical garden with spring wildflowers, blooming trees, peaceful pathways. Perfect romantic stroll. May features peak blooms. Combine with nearby museum.
dates.where: Red Butte Garden — 300 Wakara Way, Salt Lake City, UT 84108

dates.name: Horseback Riding at Sundance — Mountain Trail Rides
dates.desc: Guided horseback rides through scenic Sundance mountain trails with wildflowers and overlooks. Beginner-friendly with experienced guides. Peaceful, romantic alpine experience.
dates.where: Sundance Resort — 8841 Alpine Loop Rd, Sundance, UT 84604

dates.name: TopGolf Vineyard — Gamified Golf & Friendly Competition
dates.desc: Private bay with automatic scoring, full bar, great food. Zero golf skill required—just fun, friendly competition, and laughter. Relaxed, upbeat date night energy.
dates.where: TopGolf — 484 N Entertainment Way, Vineyard, UT

dates.name: Escape Room Challenge — Puzzle & Teamwork
dates.desc: 60-minute immersive puzzle experience with themed rooms. Solve puzzles together, race the clock, enjoy the teamwork and challenge. Great for competitive couples.
dates.where: Getout Games — 202 W 400 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Indoor Rock Climbing — Challenge Gym
dates.desc: Indoor climbing gym with varied difficulty levels. Great for teamwork, encouragement, and friendly competition. Beginner-friendly with instruction available.
dates.where: Local climbing gyms throughout Salt Lake City

dates.name: Scenic Biking — Park City Mountain Trails
dates.desc: Scenic mountain biking through Park City. Multiple trail difficulty levels. Spring weather is perfect. Beautiful views, peaceful nature, great exercise.
dates.where: Park City Mountain Resort — Park City, UT

dates.name: Craft Lake City — Local Artisan Marketplace
dates.desc: Browse and support local artists and makers. Handmade goods, unique finds, live music, food vendors. Vibrant creative energy. Discover Utah's talented maker community.
dates.where: Salt Lake City (various seasonal locations)

dates.name: Scenic Railroad — Historic Train Dining Experience
dates.desc: Unique experience riding historic trains through Utah landscapes. Gourmet dining cars, beautiful scenery, nostalgic romance. Perfect for something truly distinctive and memorable.
dates.where: Various Utah train routes

dates.name: Hot Air Balloon Sunrise Flight — Aerial Adventure
dates.desc: Magical sunrise hot air balloon flight over Utah landscapes. Floating peacefully with panoramic views. Romantic, unforgettable, bucket-list experience.
dates.where: Various launch sites near Salt Lake City

dates.name: Outdoor Summer Concert Series — Free Live Music
dates.desc: Free outdoor concerts throughout Salt Lake and Park City in summer. Bring a picnic, blanket, and enjoy live music under the stars. Perfect for budget-friendly romance.
dates.where: Various parks throughout SLC and Park City

dates.name: Comedy Night — Local Comedy Club Experience
dates.desc: Live stand-up comedy at local venues. Great laughs, casual atmosphere, fun evening of entertainment. Perfect for low-pressure fun and connection.
dates.where: The Wiseguys Comedy Club & other venues — Downtown SLC
